name: family-travel-editor
description: An AI agent skill for organizing travel footage, planning scenes and revising films in your preferred editor. Not a standalone video editor.

interface.shortDescription: Plan travel films with your AI agent
interface.longDescription: An AI agent skill, not a standalone video editor. Organize footage, reconstruct context, plan scenes and work through timecoded feedback in your preferred editor. Includes local catalogue helpers, a silent video preview and experimental video-only Resolve XML. Full audio editing and native editor control require separately available, tested tools. Start with one scene; keep a saved plan and next step.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan one scene from my travel footage using my preferred editor.
